_inherited_budget_note: The 2026/27 budget was set by the outgoing Conservative administration (12 Feb 2026). Reform UK won 7 May 2026 and formed the Executive 21 May 2026, inheriting the budget; the first Reform-set budget will be 2027/28.

administration.next_elections: Suffolk devolution / LGR programme is in progress; the county tier is time-limited.
administration.note: Reform UK won the 7 May 2026 all-out election (41 of 70) and formed the Executive at the AGM on 21 May 2026. Suffolk's May 2025 election was postponed a year for devolution / LGR (Reform UK won a legal challenge against a further delay to 2027). Composition: Reform 41, Green 13, Conservative 9, Labour 3, Liberal Democrat 2, Independent 2. Largest opposition group: Green (13); Conservative group leader Cllr Richard Rout.

mtfs.intervention_status: None (no S114, no Exceptional Financial Support, no Best Value Notice; a GBP 13.3m in-year 2025/26 overspend was reported). Severe DSG: negative reserve GBP 97.638m (Mar 2025) heading to ~GBP 161m by the override end.
